## Project Tracker 1.2.0

- New app logo: fluorescent “Progress” lettering and an ascending graph on a flat black background, applied to Android launcher icons and the web app.
- Updated the in-app wordmark to “Progress”.
- Android app data remains device-only; cloud backup and device-to-device transfer are disabled.
- Widgets show the project name and progress ring/percentage without milestone notes.
- Milestones appear below the target-date stats; new entries append and scroll into view, with tap-to-edit and long-press Edit / Delete actions.
- New milestone percentages add to current progress as the next step, capped at 100%.

The release includes local reminders, local project storage, and the independently configured transparent project widget.

Download `Project-Tracker.apk`. It uses your private release key if GitHub Actions signing secrets are configured; otherwise it is debug-signed.
